Package frc.robot.utils.targeting

Class TrackingLagEstimator

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.utils.targeting.TrackingLagEstimator
public final class TrackingLagEstimator extends Object
Measures how far a position loop lags behind a moving setpoint, in seconds.

When a servo follows a setpoint moving at a steady rate, it settles into following it a fixed time behind, so lag = tracking error / setpoint rate. Samples are only taken during steady motion: not while standing still, not on jumps (target switches, wrapping across the turret seam), and only once the motion has lasted a few lag-times so the error has settled. Accepted samples are low-pass filtered.

The measured position is older than the setpoint it is compared with (CAN status frames). While moving, that age alone looks like rate * age of tracking error, so it is subtracted.

    • TrackingLagEstimator

      public TrackingLagEstimator(double initialLagS, double minRateDegPerS, double maxRateDegPerS, double maxErrorDeg, double filterTimeConstantS, double maxLagS)
      Parameters:
      initialLagS - estimate to use until samples arrive
      minRateDegPerS - slower setpoint motion is ignored (error is mostly noise and friction)
      maxRateDegPerS - faster setpoint motion is treated as a jump, not tracking
      maxErrorDeg - larger tracking errors are ignored (the loop is catching up, not tracking)
      filterTimeConstantS - low-pass time constant applied to accepted samples
      maxLagS - the estimate is clamped to [0, maxLagS]
